questions.question: The Muhammadan Anglo-Oriental College in Aligarh was founded by ___________.
questions.solution:
• MAO College: Sir Syed Ahmed Khan
  • 1875: Later became the Aligarh Muslim University (AMU).

questions.question: Which of the following was the capital of Vatsa Mahajanapada?
questions.solution:
• Vatsa Capital: Kausambi
  • Mahajanapada: Located near the confluence of the Ganga and Yamuna (near modern Allahabad).

questions.question: Who among the following was the first sultan of Delhi Sultanate to visit the Ajmer shrine of Khwaja Muinuddin Chishti?
questions.solution:
• Ajmer Visit: Muhammad bin Tughlaq
  • Detail: He was the first Delhi Sultan to make a pilgrimage to the Dargah of Moinuddin Chishti.

questions.question: Drains exiting from Mohenjo-Daro had ________ doors that were probably closed at night to prevent vagrants or negative elements from entering the city through that access.
questions.solution:
• Mohenjo-Daro Drains: wooden
  • Sanitation: The city featured an incredible drainage system with silt pits and wooden doors for flow control.

questions.question: Who became the Nawab of Bengal after the death of Alivardi Khan in the year 1756?
questions.solution:
• Nawab of Bengal 1756: Siraj-Ud-Daulah
  • Battle: He was the Nawab during the infamous Battle of Plassey (1757).

questions.question: Which of the following Indian philosophical systems and its widely acknowledged proponents is INCORRECTLY paired?
questions.solution:
• Incorrect Philosophy: Vaisheshika - Vyasa
  • Correction: Vaisheshika was founded by Kanada. Vyasa is associated with the Brahma Sutras (Vedanta).

questions.question: Which poet composed the Allahabad Prashasti of Samudragupta?
questions.solution:
• Allahabad Prashasti: Harisena
  • Inscription: This panegyric inscribed on an Ashokan pillar provides a detailed account of Samudragupta's conquests.

questions.question: The Citadel area has a huge mud ________ platform, which is 6 m high and underlies all the construction.
questions.solution:
• Citadel Platform: brick
  • IVC: Most Harappan citadels were built on giant artificial mud-brick platforms for flood protection.

questions.question: The planned large-scale disruption of rail communications and the seizure of arms in Bengal were undertaken under the leadership of ________.
questions.solution:
• Jatin Mukherjee: Jatin Mukherjee
  • Revolution: Also known as 'Bagha Jatin', he was a key leader of the Yugantar revolutionary group.

questions.question: Shree Narayana Dharma Paripalana Yogam (SNDP), founded in 1903, to carry on the work of social reform was active in which of the following states?
questions.solution:
• SNDP Movement: Kerala
  • Leader: Founded by Narayana Guru to fight for the rights of the Ezhava community.

questions.question: Name the Sri Lankan Buddhist text that provides details of the Mauryan empire.
questions.solution:
• Dipavamsa: Dipavamsa
  • Text: A Pali chronicle of Sri Lanka that mentions Ashoka's mission to spread Buddhism.

questions.question: Under the influence of the Greeks, which of the following art styles flourished in India?
questions.solution:
• Greek Influence: Gandhar
  • Art: This Indo-Greek style is characterized by realistic human features and Greco-Roman drapery.
